intended_object: This is an auxiliary function inside the library's proof of the Moise triangulation and classification of surfaces. It sends a vertex occurrence of an "adaptive face" (a face of some level subdivision chosen adaptively with respect to an open set U) to the point of the realization that it names. The only docstring is a placeholder, "The `adaptiveVertexPoint` declaration."; the purpose is inferred from the name and from how the library uses it.
explanation: The body only unpacks the adaptive face to get its underlying level face `t.2.1`, then calls `levelFaceVertexPoint`. It is internal bookkeeping for the adaptive-subdivision construction in this proof development. Its lemmas (`adaptiveVertexPoint_mem_carrier`, `adaptiveVertexPoint_mem_boundaryVertices`, …) serve that proof. It does not correspond to a standard mathematical object that one could compare against the literature, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
